minimumGateLogic: ALL mandatory evidenced gates; missing/unknown/conflicting facts or privacy violation => BLOCKED

gates.minimumEvidence: Private original source ties full account/subaccount, ownership/authorized use and exact portfolio economic perimeter; no masked-account match
Genuine issuer attribution/original document identity and applicable current source/supersession/revocation checks are supported by authorized authenticated pre-review; hash alone insufficient
All 11 requested original positions have exact document/row references and stable instrument code/venue/class, plus ISIN or accepted-contract alternate evidence; no inferred mapping
Explicit witnessed applicability from opening snapshot through requested historical scope, precision and exceptions; actual publication/retrieval/knowledge kept separate
All relevant event/entitlement/allocation/stage references and ambiguity resolved for intended scope; FPT pending date/availability must not be guessed
Private original bytes, correct SHA-256/size, source schema/document and exact pointers, custody history, revision links and privacy-safe projection are present and coherent
Genuinely independent, authorized authenticated reviewer/role and trust/revocation/audit mechanism are available for this exact scope; no-login alone provides none
